style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: kraft-paper keys in the brown family of the wooden cube and the jar, with a magenta-marker Enter as the treat; never red or violet

images.why: Screen 'a heap of eighteen unit cubes' and Look 'a cube tray and a cuboid shelf': every unit cube of the heap, the tray and the shelf cuboids is a wooden toy block
images.prompt: A single pale natural beechwood toy building block in the shape of a perfect cube, with softly rounded edges, a fine smooth wood grain and a light honey-cream colour. It is shown in an isometric view looking down at one corner, like a cube icon, so a top face and two side faces all show and the outline is a hexagon.

images.object: tall straight-sided amber glass jar, plain sides
images.why: Look 'equal jars of water' (phases 3 and 4): each of the two equal jars is a tall amber glass jar, empty, the water level and the marks drawn in code
images.prompt: A tall straight-sided amber glass storage jar standing upright, photographed straight on from the side with the camera level with the middle of the jar, a flat front elevation in which the rim is a flat horizontal edge and the inside of the opening cannot be seen: empty, plain unmarked sides, warm honey-amber glass.

images.why: Screen 'two equal jars filled to one line, a key and a stone': the stone lowered into the jar is a real stone (the key and the cork stay plain, the three-skin cap)
images.prompt: One smooth, rounded, pale sandy-grey river stone with a few tiny darker flecks.
